nodes.description: Private owner address, set to deployer in constructor and used as the sole privileged role.
Public mapping holding token balances; written directly with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of owner to spender allowances; mutated in approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping counting how many transferFrom sales an address has performed.
Private mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass the sale condition check.
Private minimum sale value enforced by condition.
Private maximum sale value enforced by condition.
Private sale count limit enforced by condition and set by init.
Address whitelisted in ensure and settable only by owner via setTradeAddress.
Total token supply set once in the constructor.
Constant 18 decimals used to scale supply, minting and sale limits.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address whitelisted in ensure and pre-approved in constructor.
Public token name assigned in constructor.
Public token symbol assigned in constructor.
Public payable transfer that immediately delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Internal view whitelist gate that returns true for owner, UNI, the derived pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses and otherwise requires condition to pass.
Public payable transfer that decrements allowance, runs the ensure gate and mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approval that blindly writes any allowance amount for msg.sender.
Internal view evaluation of the sale count, minimum and maximum sale limits.
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-influenced address and calldata.
Pseudo-mint that overwrites an account balance and whitelists it, guarded only by owner or a hardcoded backdoor address.
Owner-only initializer that sets the sale count, minimum sale and maximum sale values.
Owner-only batch transfer that multiplies value by array length and mutates balances without overflow checks.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure deterministic Uniswap pair address derivation using the init code hash.
Payable constructor that sets metadata, supply, owner, initial balance and an unlimited UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowances, minting and ownership assignment.
Arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata executed in the token storage context.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend that can overflow.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] and grants canSale, protected only by a hardcoded privileged address.
Unchecked subtraction of allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of transferFrom when transfer is called.

msg.sender is written as the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender must equal owner before the arbitrary delegatecall is executed.
msg.sender is compared against owner and against a hardcoded privileged address to reach the mint path.

msg.sender must equal owner to run batchSend.
msg.sender must equal owner to change tradeAddress.
Deployer msg.sender becomes owner and receives the entire supply.
owner is whitelisted and short-circuits the ensure gate.
owner is the only address allowed to invoke delegate.
owner is an authorized caller of _mints.
owner is the only authorized caller of init.
owner is the only authorized caller of batchSend.
owner is the only authorized caller of setTradeAddress.
balanceOf is read and rewritten for both parties inside transferFrom.
balanceOf is overwritten for the spender inside _mints.
balanceOf is read for msg.sender and credited for each recipient in batchSend.
Deployer balance is initialized to the total supply in the constructor.
allowance is read and decremented when msg.sender differs from _from.
allowance is written unconditionally in approve.
An unlimited allowance for the UNI router is granted in the constructor.
_onSaleNum[msg.sender] is incremented with an unchecked ++ during each transferFrom.

_minSale is consulted when validating the transfer value.
_maxSale is consulted when validating the transfer value.
_saleNum gates whether any sale is permitted at all.
tradeAddress is one of the whitelisted bypass addresses in ensure.

totalSupply is computed and stored once at deployment.

decimals scales the constructor supply input.

The UNI router receives an unlimited allowance at deployment.
name is assigned from the constructor argument.
symbol is assigned from the constructor argument.
